payload.description: Classify raw offset: missing -> {kind:"missing",offset:null}; explicit null -> {kind:"null",offset:null}; exact integer 2..11 -> {kind:"integer",offset:original}; other -> {kind:"invalid",offset:null}. No bool/float/coercion/defaults/exceptions. Uses a helper, invokes it at module scope and assigns its returned object to result. Target inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
